title: The text's meaning before its adaptation
statement: When a task pairs a text with an image, performance or adaptation, establish the text's meaning first, so the other medium can't replace reading it.
detail: A Grade 5 reading course's curriculum graph puts reading figurative language before comparing a text with its multimedia versions, because adaptations often turn figurative images into pictures and the text's meaning must be established first. Its integrative poetry task weighs a poem's language and stanzas against an oral performance and an image without letting the image replace textual analysis, and requires the poem's figurative meaning before any judgment of how voice or image changes emphasis. The first link is typed soft, a supporting order rather than a gate, and no outcome was measured.

evidence.quote: Adaptations often externalize figurative images; the text meaning must be established first.
without letting the image replace textual analysis.
